title: Problems
intro: Folio left these out of your library or couldn't finish something in the last scan. Your files are safe: Folio didn't change any of them.

empty.title: No problems
empty.text: Folio found nothing to fix in the last scan.

footer.at: From the scan at {{time}}. The list updates after every scan.
footer.on: From the scan on {{date}}. The list updates after every scan.
footer.unknown: The list updates after every scan.

groups.notNfc: Names in a different Unicode form
groups.caseTwins: Names that differ only in capitals
groups.special: Items that aren't files or folders
groups.orphanedMetadata: Settings for folders that are gone
groups.notRelocated: Tags that didn't follow a move

rowTitle.ignoreRuleLine: Line {{line, number}} of your ignore rules

explanation.notUnicode: Its name has characters Windows stores incorrectly. Rename it in File Explorer; until then Folio leaves it out.

invalidName.withEnding: {{reason}} Rename it on the device that made it; until then Folio leaves it out.
invalidName.trailingDotOrSpace: Ends with a dot or a space.
invalidName.reservedName: Uses a name Windows reserves, like CON or NUL.
invalidName.dotName: Is named . or .., which Windows reserves.
invalidName.tooLong: Its name is longer than Windows allows.
invalidName.pathTooLong: Its full path is longer than Windows allows. Shorten the folders above it.

explanation.notNfc: Its name uses a Unicode form Windows treats differently, common for names typed on a Mac or iPad. Rename it in File Explorer, even to the same text, and Folio adds it.
explanation.notNfcTwin: Its name uses a Unicode form Windows treats differently, common for names typed on a Mac or iPad. Another item here has the same name in the standard form. Rename one of them.
explanation.caseTwins: iCloud and your other devices can't keep both. Rename one of them.

unreadable.denied: Windows denied access. Folio keeps what it already knew about it.
unreadable.inUse: Another app is using it. Folio tries again on the next scan.
unreadable.tooLarge: It's too large for Folio to read.
unreadable.other: Something went wrong reading it. Folio tries again on the next scan.

explanation.link: It links to another place, so Folio skips it.
explanation.special: Folio skips devices, pipes and other special items.
explanation.invalidIgnoreRule: It isn't a valid pattern, so Folio skips that line. The other lines still apply.
explanation.ignoreRulesFile: Folio couldn't read your ignore rules, so none of them apply.
explanation.gitignoreFile: Folio couldn't read this file, so none of its rules apply.

metadata.newer: A newer version of Folio saved it. Update Folio.
metadata.invalid: It's damaged. Folio uses your other settings and leaves this one alone.

explanation.orphanedMetadata: Folio has tags and settings for this folder, which isn't there anymore. They stay in case it comes back.

notRelocated.readOnly: A newer version of Folio made your settings read-only. Update Folio, and the tags follow on the next scan.
notRelocated.folderTags: It became a semester or course folder, which can't have tags.
notRelocated.tooLong: Its new path is too long for Folio's settings.
notRelocated.unreadable: A settings file couldn't be read.
